name.zh: “不是 A，而是 B”二阶反转框

mechanism.en: When 1st-order buzzwords are banned, models collapse into binary rhetorical contrast (`It's not just X — it's Y` / `这不是 A，而是 B`) that negates a strawman to elevate an abstract slogan.
mechanism.zh: 禁用一阶高频词后，模型会退回到二元否定反转（“这不是 A，而是 B”），先立稻草人再拔高抽象口号。

falsePositiveGuards: Exempts concrete numeric corrections on both sides (`不是 30 秒，而是 300 秒`, `wasn't 30s — it was 300s`).
Exempts code identifiers, filenames (`.py`), and factual root-cause statements (`报错原因不是磁盘满，而是 inode 耗尽`).

exemplar.bad: 这不是一款简单的文档检查工具，而是交付质量的底气。
exemplar.trap: 工具已至。底气自生。交付无忧。
exemplar.good: `dislop` 在发稿前标出本机路径泄露、未填占位符和超载幻灯片。

mechanism.en: Narrative drafts insert aphoristic 'not an object, but a symbol' pivots that replace concrete sensory details with abstract commentary.
mechanism.zh: 非虚构与散文稿中常见“不是器物，而是尊严/陪伴”式金句，用抽象评语打断画面感。

falsePositiveGuards: Exempts concrete location/object corrections (`停靠的不是三号站台，而是五号站台`, `He ordered tea, not coffee`).

exemplar.bad: 老周留下的那把旧刨子不是工具，而是手艺人的尊严。
exemplar.trap: 一把旧刨子。半生木工活。满手老茧。
exemplar.good: 老周退休那天把用了二十年的旧刨子擦净木屑，收进樟木箱底。

mechanism.en: Three or more consecutive ultra-short declarative fragments (`Signals drop. Photos vanish. Trust dies.`) mimic LinkedIn/landing-page dramatic copy.
mechanism.zh: 连续三句及以上 2–6 字无逗号超短断句（“信号消失。照片蒸发。体验归零。”），制造廉价广告感。

falsePositiveGuards: Skips headings, lists, and tables; requires >= 3 consecutive ultra-short sentences.

exemplar.bad: Signals drop. Photos vanish. Audits stall. Offline sync keeps all 120 inspection photos queued locally.
exemplar.trap: Offline sync isn't a fallback — it's field resilience for 120 photos.
exemplar.good: When cellular coverage drops in basement vaults, offline sync queues up to 120 inspection photos locally until reconnection.

name.zh: 中文四字套语三联排比

mechanism.en: Models string three symmetric four-character modifier blocks (`精准高效、安全可靠、灵活易用`) to sound polished without adding verifiable claims.
mechanism.zh: 模型高频堆砌三组对称四字形容词（“精准高效、安全可靠、灵活易用”），看起来工整但没有可核验信息。

falsePositiveGuards: Exempts proper-noun entity lists (`北京大学、清华大学、复旦大学`), book titles (`《...》`), and broken function-word slices.

exemplar.bad: 新版网关具备精准高效、安全可靠、灵活易用的特性，单节点支持 8,000 QPS。
exemplar.trap: 新版网关不是简单升级，而是 8,000 QPS 的性能飞跃。
exemplar.good: 新版网关单节点支持 8,000 QPS，并在上游超时 2 秒后自动熔断。

mechanism.en: AI product copy frequently packs three parallel value propositions into one sentence joined by two semicolons (`X happens; Y improves; Z ships`), producing ad-copy symmetry even with zero banned buzzwords.
mechanism.zh: 即便不用任何禁用词，AI 仍习惯用两个分号把三个卖点工整并排塞进同一句（“硬伤直接划掉；套话给出提醒；改完再来复查。”），读起来像宣发海报。

falsePositiveGuards: Exempts parenthetical academic citations (`(Smith, 2020; Chen, 2021; Wu, 2022)`).
Exempts single-semicolon two-clause contrasts and code/table lines.

exemplar.bad: 不能发的硬伤，系统直接划掉；听着像套话的地方，它在页边提醒你；等你改完，再拿原稿逐条对一遍。
exemplar.trap: 硬伤划掉。套话提醒。原稿复核。
exemplar.good: 系统先标出不能发的硬伤和套话。你改完之后，再跑一次检查确认没有新问题。

name.zh: 散文三段分号工整排比

mechanism.en: AI literary drafts stage three atmospheric clauses in one semicolon-joined tricolon (`Water meets beans; steam curls; the first sip steadies...`), flattening authentic rhythm.
mechanism.zh: 散文生成稿高频用两个分号工整堆砌三段意象排比，读起来像配音朗诵稿。

exemplar.bad: 街道两旁的树叶逐渐染上金黄；午后的阳光变得柔和而绵长；行人的衣领也悄然立了起来。
exemplar.trap: 树叶金黄。阳光柔和。衣领立起。
exemplar.good: 下午三点风凉下来，路口骑车的人把夹克拉链拉到下巴，梧桐叶顺着路沿滚进排水口。

name.zh: AI 自问自答式过渡句

mechanism.en: Models simulate conversational engagement by posing a stock rhetorical question and answering it immediately (`Why does this matter? Because...`, `The result? ...`, `为什么这很重要？因为……`).
mechanism.zh: 模型常在正文里自设短问句再立刻作答（“为什么这很重要？因为……”“结果呢？……”），制造刻意互动感。

falsePositiveGuards: Skips FAQ headings (`## ...?`), blockquotes, and lines inside dialogue quotes.

exemplar.bad: Why does this matter? Because unindexed queries stall checkout traffic during flash sales.
exemplar.trap: This isn't just an index tweak — it's checkout survival.
exemplar.good: Unindexed queries stall checkout traffic during flash sales, so we added a composite index on `(store_id, created_at)`.

name.zh: 散文主持词式自问自答

mechanism.en: Narrative essays lecture the reader with staged rhetorical questions (`Why does a loaf baked at dawn taste different? Because...`) instead of showing the scene.
mechanism.zh: 散文段落以自问自答替代场景描写，像主持词而非真实叙述。

falsePositiveGuards: Real reported speech and dialogue stay exempt.

exemplar.bad: Why does brewing pour-over coffee feel so grounding? Because the deliberate pace invites us to pause.
exemplar.trap: Warm water. Slow pour. Quiet pause.
exemplar.good: At 6:30 a.m. he weighed 18 grams of beans and poured slowly until the kettle stopped hissing.

name.zh: 模板化两面平衡让步句式

mechanism.en: RLHF neutrality bias pushes models into stock balanced-concession templates (`While X presents challenges, it also offers tremendous opportunities`, `虽然……面临一定挑战，但不可否认它也带来了巨大机遇`).
mechanism.zh: RLHF 中立偏好使模型高频写出“虽然……存在一定挑战，但同时也带来了前所未有的机遇”这类两面讨好空壳。

falsePositiveGuards: Only triggers when BOTH concession marker AND stock abstract opportunity/challenge clichés co-occur in the same sentence.

exemplar.bad: While remote work presents certain challenges, it also offers tremendous opportunities for organizational flexibility.
exemplar.trap: Remote work isn't a compromise — it's the future of flexibility.
exemplar.good: Remote teams saved 4 hours of weekly commute time per engineer, though onboarding new hires took two weeks longer.

mechanism.en: Copy drafts bolt on a shareable pull-quote punchline (`The pen stays in your hand`, `Built for the future`, `这才是……真正的温度/力量/价值`, `笔一直在你手里`).
mechanism.zh: 段尾强行加一句适合做分享卡片的广告金句（如“这才是好工具真正的温度”“笔一直在你手里”“为未来而生”）。

falsePositiveGuards: Targeted specifically at high-precision slogan punchline stems at sentence/paragraph end.

exemplar.bad: 工具会自动标出问题。这才是好工具真正的温度，笔一直在你手里。
exemplar.trap: 工具标出问题。你握着笔。
exemplar.good: 工具只标出问题行号，改不改、怎么改都由你自己决定。
